name: git-identity-guard
description: Blocks commits, pushes, and pull request creation when the Git or GitHub identity does not match the configured user.

interface.shortDescription: Verify identity before commits, pushes, and pull requests
interface.longDescription: Installs Git hooks and PreToolUse guards so every commit, push, and gh pr create uses the configured GitHub and Git identity.
interface.defaultPrompt: Install Git Identity Guard for this repository using my GitHub user and email.
